purpose: the per-agent F_i, alpha_i, beta_i, weight limit and fuel series behind agent_calibration.csv, with the rule and evidence for every value
status: every F_i and alpha_i is one whole reading from the calibration evidence. the fuel percentage is not stored: every agent resolves it from one shared series at each order's own date

rules.weight_limit: a parcel-corner agent is capped at the weight its own calibration service documents in the pinned Posti record; freight has no cap
rules.fuel: one shared series for every agent

shared_fuel_series.basis: one common temporal fuel-cost signal for every agent. Matkahuolto Lavarahti has the best coverage of the v5 window among the usable pinned series: 22 dated observations inside the window and no day carried past its last observation. absolute surcharge levels published by different carriers sit on different bases and are not comparable, so agents do not differ by fuel series in v5

unusable_series.posti_parcel: no observation on or before the window start 2025-10-15: posti_parcel: no observation on or before 2025-10-15, the series starts at 2026-09-02. there is no policy for pricing a date the source does not cover
unusable_series.posti_freight: no observation on or before the window start 2025-10-15: posti_freight: no observation on or before 2025-10-15, the series starts at 2026-09-02. there is no policy for pricing a date the source does not cover
unusable_series.matkahuolto_rahti: no observation on or before the window start 2025-10-15: matkahuolto_rahti: no observation on or before 2025-10-15, the series starts at 2026-01-01. there is no policy for pricing a date the source does not cover

fuel_mapping_change: this replaces the earlier per-agent carrier-series mapping. that mapping made the carriers' incomparable percentage bases decide which agents won, an artifact of the evidence rather than a real difference between agents; agent-specific fuel variation is not undesirable in principle

posti_express_freight_zone0_loose_to_hal.service: Express Freight 14, zone 0, door to door
posti_express_freight_zone0_loose_to_hal.arithmetic: alpha = (62.3200 - 40.0000) / (500.0000 - 35.0000) = 0.0480 EUR/kg; F = 40.0000 - 0.0480 x 35.0000 = 38.3200 EUR; with the separate pickup the route needs at the manufacturer: F = 38.3200 + 40.33 = 78.6500 EUR
posti_express_freight_zone0_loose_to_hal.pickup: included: Posti's separate pickup of one transport unit, 40.33 EUR

posti_express_freight_zone0_half_pallet_.arithmetic: alpha = (89.5900 - 62.3200) / (1000.0000 - 500.0000) = 0.0545 EUR/kg; F = 62.3200 - 0.0545 x 500.0000 = 35.0500 EUR; with the separate pickup the route needs at the manufacturer: F = 35.0500 + 40.33 = 75.3800 EUR
posti_express_freight_zone0_half_pallet_.pickup: included: Posti's separate pickup of one transport unit, 40.33 EUR

matkahuolto_lavarahti_1_49km_100_149_to_.service: Lavarahti pallet freight, 1-49 km band, mandatory pickup included

readings_excluded.matkahuolto_lavarahti secants without pi: Lavarahti pickup is mandatory ('Palveluun kuuluu aina nouto'), so a reading without it leaves out a charge every shipment pays
readings_excluded.posti_express_freight zone 0 secants wit: the route starts at the manufacturer, so collection is needed; the with-pickup reading of the same secant is used instead
readings_excluded.posti_express_freight zones 1 to 5: the zones are not defined in the price list and their prices rise with zone, so they carry distance that beta_i already represents
readings_excluded.posti_express_freight marginal full pall: an alpha-only reading with no fixed charge, so it is not a coherent F and alpha pair
readings_excluded.posti_express_freight whole-unit prices: valid only up to one unit's gross weight; as an F and alpha pair it would price every heavier shipment at the same amount
readings_excluded.posti Express Parcel zone fee variants: the fee depends on the destination postal code zone, and the postal-code zone list is not pinned, so it cannot be mapped to the seven cities
readings_excluded.postnord_parcel_zones: not identifiable: one weight bracket per zone cannot separate F from alpha, and its metadata could not be read (HTTP 403)
